paite: Kumpipa aw, ka Pathian, ka hon pahtawi ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
heading: David Phatna La

paite: Niteng in ka hon phat ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi; athupidan suikhiak vual ahi kei hi.
Suan khat in suan dang kiang ah na thilhihte aphat sawnsawn ding a, na thilhih thupitakte atheisak ding hi.
Nangmah pahtawina kilawmdan thupitak leh na thillamdang hihte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Mite'n na thilhih mulkimhuaite hatdan agen ding ua; ke'n leng na thupidan ka theisak sam ding hi.
Na hoihna thupitak atheih uh agen ding ua, na diktatna nuamsatak in la in asa ding uhi.
TOUPA mihehpih thei, chitna a dim, lungnel, zahngaihna thupitak nei ahi.
TOUPA bangkim tung ah leng ahoih hi; athilsiamte tung ah zahngaihnate a-om hi.
TOUPA aw, na thilsiam teng in na kiang ah kipahthu ahon hilh ding ua; misiangthoute'n nang ahon phat ding uhi.
Na gam thupidan thu gen in, na thilhihtheihna thu houlimna in azang ding ua;
Mihing tate kiang a athilhih thupitakte leh agam kilawmna thupidan theisak ding in.
Na gam tangtawn gam ding ahi a, na thuneihna suan om sung teng in a-om gige ding hi. TOUPA athute ah amuanhuai a, anasepte ah deihsak asiam hi.
TOUPA'N apukte alen gige a, kun kheukheu a omte akaitang hi.
Amau tengteng mit nang tung ah atu a; ahuntak ah an nek ding uh na pia hi;
na khut na zak a, thil hing teng deih na hihtaisak hi.
TOUPA alampi tengteng ah adik a, anasep peuhmah a mihehpih thei ahi.
TOUPA amah min lou tengteng kiang ah anai hi; thudik a amah lou peuhmahte kiang ah.
Amah laute deihlam ahihtangtung ding a; akahna uh aza ding a, ahondam ding hi.
Amah it tengteng TOUPA'N ahawi a; himahleh migilou ahihmangthang ding.
TOUPA phatna ka kam in agen ding a; sa tengteng in amin siangthou tangtawn tangtawn in phat uhen!
